picks.headline: DeepMind introduces AlphaProof Code, generating 3M Lean proof lines for Signal
picks.why: Demonstrates deep automated formal verification of production-grade cryptographic implementations.
picks.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth

picks.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models on AWS
picks.why: Brings Anthropic's newest autonomous reasoning and technical workload models to AWS enterprise infrastructure.
picks.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 on AWS

picks.headline: Meta launches Muse Ember 1.0 with 1M-token context for agent subtasks
picks.why: Provides an efficient, small reasoning model specifically optimized for low-latency tool calls and routing.
picks.title: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember

picks.headline: OpenAI deploys Control Room system to forcibly halt hazardous research workloads
picks.why: Establishes centralized infrastructure kill-switches to isolate and terminate training or inference during safety incidents.
picks.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure

picks.headline: Microsoft AI vulnerability scanner uncovers memory safety bugs in Rust core
picks.why: Demonstrates that agentic systems can find real, non-trivial soundness issues in heavily audited core systems libraries.
picks.title: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust

picks.headline: Coding agents propagate existing repo vulnerabilities into new code
picks.why: Quantifies the risk of autonomous coding tools amplifying legacy vulnerable contexts in C/C++ projects by up to 35%.
picks.title: Coding Agents Propagate Vulnerabilities in Code Bases

picks.headline: LoRA backdoor defenses fail under fine-tuning despite zero-percent initial attack rate
picks.why: Reveals that subspace projection merely suppresses triggers, allowing full backdoor reactivation after just two fine-tuning epochs.
picks.title: Suppression Is Not Erasure: Mechanistic Analysis and Reactivation Boundaries of Subspace Projection for LoRA Backdoor Defense

picks.headline: Meta and community extend LLDB to debug unified CPU and GPU sessions
picks.why: Eliminates context switching in low-level AI engineering by bridging CPU and accelerator execution inside a single lldb session.
picks.title: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs

papers.headline: FP4 pretraining requires 1.52x more exposures than BF16 for rare facts
papers.why: Proves that 4-bit floating-point quantization degrades rare-fact memorization even when validation loss curves look identical.
papers.title: What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts

papers.headline: Internal model representations and interpretability probes transfer across LLM architectures
papers.why: Shows that refusal vectors and linear probes can be mapped between distinct models using purely unlabeled prompt alignments.
papers.title: Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific

papers.headline: Bfloat16 rounding errors in recurrent states bloat hybrid reasoning outputs
papers.why: Identifies that round-to-nearest in bfloat16 recurrent states increases reasoning trajectory lengths, fixable with stochastic rounding.
papers.title: Lost in Rounding: bf16 Recurrent State Makes Hybrid Reasoning Models Think Longer
